svg.title: Example: signal alignment vs defects fixed
svg.desc: Illustrative scatter plot. Each point is an evaluation signal. X axis is how well the signal ranks planted skill variants; Y axis is the percentage of planted defects fixed when the improvement method optimizes against that signal. Points rise from generic LLM judge at bottom left to the full evaluation head at top right, along a dashed trend line.
svg.text: Signal alignment: ranks planted variants correctly (%)
